basic_info.description: Welcome to 158-162 Henry St! This rare offering features an elegant, vacant 3-unit Victorian building in the heart of the desirable Duboce Triangle. Family compound or investment with projected $222k in annual income. Natural light and vintage architectural details abound in this trophy building. Tall windows and 10-foot ceilings that add an unparalleled sense of grandeur and openness. It also presents a high-end investment opportunity for investors or additional income for owner-users.   Each flat has an in-unit washer and dryer and shares a lush backyard and ample storage space. Discover the allure of the Duboce Triangle, a hidden gem in the heart of San Francisco. Steps to Hayes Valley, the Castro, the Haight, This vibrant neighborhood beautifully blends historic charm with convenient, modern urban living, offering an exceptional lifestyle for its residents.
